title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Let me know what you think about these questions

Is working at the mask-making facility voluntary or mandatory for employees?In either case, voluntary or mandatory, if an employee decides against working at the mask-making facility, will they be terminated or subject to unpaid furlough? If unpaid furlough, how long?What are the masks for?How many employees were chosen to work mask-making shifts and how were they chosen?What is the company’s current policy on working from home during the pandemic? When was it in put in place?If there is a policy in place about employees working from home, does the company feel it is safe to have employees working in a facility?What kind of physical labor will the employees be doing at the facility?What are the company's safety and social distancing guidelines for working at the facility?
